raw.description: Ingest screenshot(s) via base64 or file path, check the visual state cache, and return state details. On cache miss, generates perceptual hashes (dHash/aHash), CLIP embeddings, and persists a new visual state entry. Use this tool AFTER capturing a screenshot and BEFORE invoking vision LLMs to avoid redundant token spend. For batch ingestion, pass an `items` array instead of a single screenshot/file_path.

accessibility_tree.description: Optional JSON string representing the simplified AX tree

description.description: Optional human/agent-provided description of the screen

file_path.description: Absolute path to a local image file (single mode). Use instead of screenshot to avoid base64 overhead

force_refresh.description: Bypass L1/L2 cache and force new ingestion

items.description: Batch mode: array of 1–20 screenshot items to ingest/analyze. When provided, screenshot/file_path params are ignored.

response_format.description: Response verbosity. compact omits internal fields like hashes, vectors, AX trees. Default: compact

source_url.description: Optional app/page path or URL where captured

trace_id.description: Optional session_id or trace_id for correlation with state-memory-mcp

raw.name: analyze_screenshot

raw.description: Compare two visual states structurally (dHash, CLIP vector, JSON diff, layout delta) or two video trajectories (keyframe similarity, divergence point). Provide state_a_id/state_b_id for state comparison, or video_a_id/video_b_id for video trajectory comparison.

state_a_id.description: ID of visual state A (state comparison mode)

state_b_id.description: ID of visual state B (state comparison mode)

raw.name: compare_states

raw.description: Package keyframe IDs, dHash/CLIP fingerprints, OCR snippets, and linked state-memory node IDs into an immutable, cryptographically hashable evidence pack for compliance and audit trails.

keyframe_state_ids.description: Array of keyframe visual state IDs

linked_state_memory_nodes.description: State memory node IDs linked to this visual evidence pack

raw.name: create_evidence_pack

raw.description: Export visual state transition trajectories. Formats: "json" (raw state steps), "llava" / "qwen2_vl" (VLM fine-tuning datasets), "joint" (interleaved workflow events correlated by session/trace ID for state-memory-mcp).

limit.description: Maximum number of states to export (default: 50)

trace_id.description: Optional trace ID / session ID filter (used with joint format)

raw.name: export_trajectories

raw.description: Purge a specific visual state, its vector embeddings, and perceptual hashes from storage for privacy or memory reset.

state_id.description: ID of visual state to purge

raw.name: forget_state

raw.description: Trace historical pathways from current state to a target state or state matching description via BFS over the transition graph.

from_state_id.description: ID of starting state (defaults to most recently accessed state)

raw.name: get_navigation_paths

raw.description: Fetch aggregated visual context: recent states, frequently accessed states, active transitions, and memory stats. Call this at session start to orient before performing UI actions.
raw.name: get_session_context

raw.description: Manage visual memory snapshots. Actions: "save" creates a named checkpoint of current states; "diff" compares two snapshots for visual drift/regression; "export" serializes a snapshot to a portable JSON archive; "restore" imports a snapshot from an exported archive.

archive_json.description: JSON string of exported SnapshotArchive (required for restore)

description.description: Notes describing snapshot context (used with save)

snapshot_b_name.description: Target snapshot name to compare against (required for diff)

state_memory_milestone_id.description: Optional state-memory milestone ID to correlate

state_memory_snapshot_id.description: Optional state-memory snapshot ID to correlate

raw.name: manage_snapshot

raw.description: Manage WebM, MP4, and GIF video recordings in visual memory. Actions: "ingest" extracts keyframes, deduplicates, and builds sequence transitions; "search" queries stored video recordings by keyword/category/tags; "timeline" retrieves the chronological keyframe timeline for a specific video_id.

file_path.description: Absolute file path to video file (for 'ingest')

fps.description: Frame sampling rate per second for 'ingest' (default: 1.0)

video_id.description: Video record ID to retrieve timeline (required for 'timeline')

raw.name: manage_video

raw.description: Manage Visual Spec baseline contracts (Visual SDD). Actions: "set" registers a screenshot or design mockup as baseline, "verify" tests a live UI screenshot against a baseline, "list" returns all registered visual specs.

file_path.description: Absolute file path to image (for 'set' or 'verify')

sdd_requirement_id.description: Optional state-memory-mcp SDD requirement node ID for 'verify'

tolerance.description: dHash Hamming distance tolerance threshold for 'verify' (default: 8)

raw.name: manage_visual_spec

raw.description: Predict the best next UI action from the current visual state based on transition success rates, goal alignment, and grounded AX tree element targeting.

current_state_id.description: ID of current active visual state

detect_traps.description: Whether to analyze state for modal backdrops, loops, and visual traps (default: true)

raw.name: predict_next_action

raw.description: Search visual state memory by screenshot image, text query, or accessibility tree. Read-only — never creates or modifies states. Use analyze_screenshot to ingest new states.

file_path.description: Absolute file path to search by local image

query.description: Text query string for semantic vector search

screenshot.description: Base64 image payload to search by visual appearance

raw.name: recall_memory

raw.description: Log an action transition between two visual states and update transition statistics. Call this after every click/type/scroll/navigate action. When action_type is "blocker", generates a structured visual blocker payload for state-memory-mcp instead of recording a transition (from_state_id becomes the visual_state_id of the blocker).

action.description: Action description (or blocker description when action_type is "blocker")

action_type.description: Category of UI action. Use "blocker" to create a visual blocker payload.

from_state_id.description: Source state ID (or blocker visual_state_id when action_type is "blocker")

project.description: state-memory-mcp project name (only used when action_type is "blocker")

success.description: Whether action succeeded (default: true, ignored for blockers)

to_state_id.description: Destination state ID (not required when action_type is "blocker")

raw.name: record_outcome

raw.description: Revert the most recent visual state ingestion or transition edge addition on the current git branch.

type.description: Type of mutation to revert (default: any — reverts the most recent of either)

raw.name: undo_visual_mutation

raw.description: Poll for a target visual state ID until it exists in memory or timeout occurs. Use this to avoid agent spin-loops when waiting for asynchronous screenshots.

target_state_id.description: Target visual state ID to wait for

raw.name: wait_for_visual_state
